transcript.text: ¡Hola, soy Sparky! Estoy muy feliz de verte hoy. Mira, traje mi caja de juguetes espaciales, ¿me ayudas a elegir uno? I want the red ball.
That is a great choice! The red ball is bouncy and fun. Do you like the red ball too?
Yes, too means also! Like, I like the ball, and you like the ball too. Do you want to play with the red ball?
You got it! Let's play with the red ball together. Catch the ball!

You caught the ball, excellent work! Today we played and had so much fun with the red ball together. I loved sharing my space toys with you and I cannot wait for our next adventure to see what other games we can play.
